routes.name: Primary publishable route for Millennium Prize Problem: The Hodge Conjecture — Algebraic Cycles, Weil Classes, and Singular/Integral Obstructions
routes.reason: Clay Millennium Problem (The Hodge Conjecture): For smooth projective complex varieties X (and contrasted singular/integral extensions), pursue a publishable mathematical theorem or exact obstruction: either (a) prove a new algebraicity or transcendental-rank / Mumford-Tate obstruction theorem for Hodge/Weil classes on a concrete family of fourfolds or abelian varieties of Weil type, or (b) construct and certify an explicit singular projective variety or integral Hodge torsion counterexample with exact cohomological/period certificates, clearly distinguishing the smooth rational Hodge conjecture from singular/integral variants.
